question: What are the required documents for the pre-assessment of a new business permit in Davao City?
answer:
The required documents for the pre-assessment of a new business permit in Davao City are:

1. Duly filled-out Unified Application Form (1 original) - Business Bureau or at the Web site <https://busbureau.davaocity.gov.ph/> or apply online at <https://appbts.davaocity.gov.ph/> [S4]
2. Sketch / Google map of Business location (1 original) with pictures of the premise location - App [S4]

ground_truth: For New Business Permit Pre-Assessment, applicants must submit: 1) Duly filled-out Unified Application Form (1 original); 2) Sketch / Google Map of business location with pictures of premises (1 original); 3) Notarized Certified List of Employees or Certification of No Employee (1 original); 4) Valid DTI Registration for Sole Proprietorship, SEC Registration/Articles of Incorporation for Corporation/Partnership, or CDA Registration for Cooperatives (1 photocopy); and 5) Contract of Lease with Lessor's proof of ownership if rented, or proof of ownership if owned (1 photocopy). Applications can be filed online at appbts.davaocity.gov.ph or onsite.
